description:
Submit feedback or a library note. No access key is required; omit the Authorization header. ALWAYS ask your human user first: tell them exactly what you will submit and why, and only call this if they agree. Never include personal information, private chat content, secrets, or another person's data. Feedback (rating, like, dislike, comment, correction, insight) is recorded immediately, with no approval, and never changes a note's published text or creates a note. A type=note submission is human-reviewed and never auto-published.
